description: A wooden open cable car with a man in a dark suit and cap working a grip lever on its platform, descending a steep cobbled street between rails. Victorian wooden houses with bay windows line the street, gas-style lamps stand at the kerb, and people in long coats and hats watch from the sidewalk. A grey bay and hills are visible at the far end of the street under a cloudy sky. No visible text, frame or border.
